scripts.audio-assets: uv run --no-project --with numpy --with soundfile --with scipy python ../sfx.py && uv run --no-project --with numpy --with soundfile --with librosa --with pyloudnorm python ../music.py
scripts.render: npm run prepare-assets --silent && node scripts/render.mjs render
scripts.still: npm run prepare-assets --silent && node scripts/render.mjs still
